jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Equinox Hospitality . The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc.  The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

Job Summary

-

Oversee day-to-day HR operations for our California workforce, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, benefits administration, and compliance.

-

Partner with leadership to develop and implement HR practices that support business goals while complying with federal, state, and local employment laws.

Activities & Responsibilities

Recruitment & Staffing

-

Manage full-cycle recruiting for California roles: job postings, screening, interviewing coordination, and offer process.

-

Ensure job postings and hiring practices comply with California pay transparency, salary history, medical inquiry, and driver’s license rules (for applicable roles).

-

Coordinate background checks and reference checks in compliance with applicable fair chance and privacy laws.

Onboarding & New Hire Processes

-

Facilitate onboarding for new employees, including orientation, required trainings, and collection of new-hire paperwork.

-

Provide required state and local new-hire notices and disclosures (e.g., wage notice/“wage theft” form, lactation accommodation policy, workers’ compensation pamphlet, unemployment/paid family leave booklets, sexual harassment notice, survivor leave notice, “Know Your Rights” worker notice when applicable, and any relevant city/county minimum wage or sick leave notices).

-

Ensure accurate reporting of new hires to the California Employment Development Department (EDD), coordinating with payroll or third-party providers as needed.

Employee Relations & Performance Management

-

Serve as a primary contact for employee questions and concerns regarding HR policies, benefits, leave, and workplace conduct.

-

Advise managers on performance management, documentation, corrective action, and terminations consistent with California and federal law.

-

Support investigations into complaints of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, and other workplace concerns; document findings and recommend corrective measures.

-

Promote a respectful, inclusive workplace and support reasonable accommodation processes for disabilities, pregnancy, and religion.

Compliance & Policies

-

Help maintain and update the employee handbook and standalone policies to reflect current California and local requirements (e.g., leaves of absence, paid sick leave, meal and rest breaks, lactation accommodation, anti-harassment, equal employment opportunity, business expense reimbursement).

-

Coordinate posting and distribution of required federal, state, and local workplace notices/posters (including minimum wage, whistleblower protections, harassment/discrimination, leave rights, etc.).

-

Monitor changes in employment laws affecting California operations and communicate updates to management.

-

Maintain required employment records and personnel files; respond to employee requests to access their records within required timeframes.

Compensation, Benefits & Time Off

-

Partner with leadership on pay decisions consistent with California equal pay and pay transparency requirements.

-

Work with payroll and benefits vendors to administer benefits, leave programs, and time-off policies (e.g., California Family Rights Act, pregnancy disability leave, paid sick leave, local sick leave ordinances where applicable).

-

Support annual pay reviews and ensure job titles, wage history, and other required records are properly maintained.

Training & Culture

-

Coordinate mandatory California trainings, including:

-

Sexual harassment and abusive conduct prevention training for supervisors and non-supervisors.

-

Any industry-specific trainings (e.g., human trafficking awareness for covered hospitality employers).

-

Provide or coordinate training for managers and employees on key policies (harassment, discrimination, retaliation prevention, safety, timekeeping, leave, accommodations).

-

Assist with engagement initiatives, culture-building activities, and recognition programs.

Education and Experience

-

Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

-

Typically, 3–5+ years of progressive HR experience, including experience supporting employees in California.

-

Prior experience in a supervisory or HR lead role strongly preferred.

Preferred

-

PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, or similar HR certification.

-

Any California-focused HR coursework or certifications are a plus.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

-

Solid working knowledge of California and federal employment laws and regulations, including areas such as:

-

Anti-discrimination/harassment and retaliation protections

-

Wage-and-hour rules (minimum wage, overtime, meal and rest periods, pay transparency)

-

Leave laws and reasonable accommodations

-

Required notices, postings, and training

-

Strong interpersonal and communication skills; ability to build trust with employees and managers at all levels.

-

Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

-

Excellent problem-solving, conflict resolution, and organizational skills.

-

Proficiency with HRIS platforms and MS Office or Google Workspace tools.

-

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

-

Punctual and dependable

-

Attention to detail and accuracy

-

Multi-tasking

-

Organizing and prioritizing

-

Problem analysis and problem-solving skills

-

Ability to work independently and with others

-

Professional integrity

-

Ability to meet deadlines

-

Leadership skills to motivate and develop staff

-

Ability to work effectively under time constraints and deadlines

401(k), Dental insurance, Employee discount, Health insurance, Life insurance, Paid time off, Vision insurance.

This company is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing the Human Resources Strategy

• Executes and follows-up on engagement survey related activities.

• Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.

• Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions

• Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.

• Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.

• Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow-up.

• Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.

• Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.

• Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.

• Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.

• Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.

• Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.

• Supervises one or more on-property Human Resources, as well as market-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.

Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process

• Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.

• Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.

• Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.

• Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.

• Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.

• Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.

• Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.

Managing Employee Compensation Strategy

• Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.

• Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.

• Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.

• Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.

• Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.

Managing Staff Development Activities

• Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).

• Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.

• Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.

• Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing the Human Resources Strategy

• Executes and follows-up on engagement survey related activities.

• Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.

• Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions

• Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.

• Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.

• Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow-up.

• Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.

• Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.

• Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.

• Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.

• Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.

• Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.

• Supervises one or more on-property Human Resources, as well as market-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.

Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process

• Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.

• Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.

• Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.

• Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.

• Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.

• Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.

• Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.

Managing Employee Compensation Strategy

• Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.

• Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.

• Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.

• Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.

• Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.

Managing Staff Development Activities

• Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).

• Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.

• Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.

• Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Assist and support management and the leadership team with handling and resolving Human Resources issues. Assist employees with internal and external transfer requests and procedures. Monitor and assist managers/supervisors with hiring processes and issues. Coordinate and conduct applicant drug screens, reference checks, background checks, motor vehicle checks, and social security number verification. Maintain applicant flow, drug screen, orientation and transfer request logs. Create and maintain new hire and personnel files and enter them into Human Resources Information Systems. Assist with orientation of new employees. Monitor all hiring and recruitment processes for compliance with all local, state, and federal laws and company policies and standards. Ensure accurate maintenance of all employee records and files (e.g., interview documents, I-9's). Support processing and maintenance of payroll records in accordance with policies and procedures, as necessary. Inform Human Resources management of issues related to employee relations within the division or property. Create and maintain filing systems. Generate Human Resources data reports as necessary Answer phone calls and record messages. Create and type office correspondence using computer. Serve as Human Resources subject matter expert and participate on project teams. Train new hires on Human Resources processes, programs, policies, information systems, etc.

Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

jobs.description:
Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Davidson Hospitality Group. The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc.  The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

Are you a passionate and strategic HR leader ready to make a meaningful impact at an iconic resort destination?

We’re looking for a Director of Human Resources to lead the people strategy at Sheraton Kauai, creating an exceptional team member experience while supporting the hotel’s continued success.

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on hospitality HR leader who thrives in a dynamic resort environment and is passionate about building strong teams, developing talent, and creating a culture where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.

What You’ll Do

-

Lead and oversee all aspects of Human Resources for the resort, including recruitment, employee relations, talent management, performance management, and HR programs and policies

-

Partner with the General Manager and senior leadership team to develop and execute HR strategies that support business and operational goals

-

Build and strengthen a culture of engagement, accountability, inclusion, and service excellence

-

Develop creative strategies to attract, retain, and develop top hospitality talent

-

Lead employee engagement, recognition, performance management, and talent development initiatives

-

Provide coaching, guidance, and HR expertise to leaders and team members at all levels

-

Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations

-

Serve as a trusted advisor to property leadership on employee relations and employment matters

-

Stay current on HR trends, best practices, and evolving employment legislation

-

Help shape a positive and high-performing workplace culture that reflects the unique spirit of Sheraton Kauai Coconut Beach Resort

What You’ll Do

-

Lead and oversee all aspects of Human Resources for the resort, including recruitment, employee relations, talent management, performance management, and HR programs and policies

-

Partner with the General Manager and senior leadership team to develop and execute HR strategies that support business and operational goals

-

Build and strengthen a culture of engagement, accountability, inclusion, and service excellence

-

Develop creative strategies to attract, retain, and develop top hospitality talent

-

Lead employee engagement, recognition, performance management, and talent development initiatives

-

Provide coaching, guidance, and HR expertise to leaders and team members at all levels

-

Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations

-

Serve as a trusted advisor to property leadership on employee relations and employment matters

-

Stay current on HR trends, best practices, and evolving employment legislation

-

Help shape a positive and high-performing workplace culture that reflects the unique spirit of Sheraton Kauai Coconut Beach Resort

What We’re Looking For

-

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred, or a minimum of 4 years of progressive HR experience

-

Prior hotel or resort HR experience required

-

Strong background in employment law, recruiting, employee relations, and talent retention

-

Proven experience leading employee engagement, performance management, and talent development initiatives

-

Strong understanding of EEO, FMLA, ADA, OSHA, and other applicable employment laws and regulations

-

Ability to effectively advise and influence property leadership on HR matters

-

Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills

-

Experience supporting and leading a diverse workforce

-

High degree of confidentiality, sound judgment, and common sense

-

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced hospitality environment and remain flexible through changing priorities

-

Affirmative Action experience is a plus

-

SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP certification preferred

Davidson Hospitality Group is an award-winning, full-service hospitality management company overseeing hotels, restaurants, dining and entertainment venues across the US.

A trusted partner and preferred operator for Hilton, Hyatt, Kimpton, Marriott, and Margaritaville, Davidson offers a unique entrepreneurial management style and owners’ mentality that provides the individualized personal service of a small company, enhanced by the breadth and depth of skill and experience of a larger company. In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value, Davidson is comprised of four highly specialized operating verticals: Davidson Hotels, Pivot, Davidson Resorts and Davidson Restaurant Group.

In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value to its owners and team members, Davidson offers a rich benefit program with a variety of benefits designed to enrich the lives and well-being of our team members and their families.

Multiple Tiers of Medical Coverage Dental & Vision Coverage 24/7 Teledoc service Free Maintenance Medications Pet Insurance Hotel Discounts Tuition Reimbursement Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, bereavement, and Holidays).  401K Match Working at Davidson is like nowhere else.

It’s less of a job, more of a calling. It’s part career, part revolution. Because whatever you do here, you play a part in helping redefine the way quality hospitality is delivered to our guests, our clients, our partners, and each other.

EOE AA- Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation

Davidson Hospitality is a drug free workplace.  Pre-employment drug test and background check required.  We participate in E-Verify.

This company is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources Operations
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Executes strategies that serve to attract, retain and develop diverse premiere talent. Position directs and works with human resource employees on recruitment, total compensation, employee relations and training and development. Executes against objectives outlined in the Human Resource Business Plan and delivers services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success. Ensures compliance with applicable laws and regulations as well as Standard Operating Procedures.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Legal and Compliance Practices

• Ensures terminated employee files are retained for the required length of time.

• Ensures compliance on all human resource audits.

• Ensures proper documentation of all progressive disciplinary action is kept in employee file.

• Ensures compliance with key policies (e.g., Sexual Harassment, Non-Harassment, Non-Discrimination, No Solicitation).

• Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims.

• Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

• Ensures Guarantee of Fair Treatment policy is consistently followed and proper documentation is maintained on all disciplinary issues.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably and that issues are brought to resolution.

• Administers property policies fairly and consistently.

• Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

Managing Human Resources Communication

• Communicates changes to the benefit plans in a timely manner.

• Communicates property rules and regulations via an employee handbook.

• Coaches managers on progressive discipline process.

Managing Staffing and Employee Development Activities

• Participates in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resources employee team members.

• Ensures performance evaluations and merit increase paperwork are maintained in employee files.

• Manages performance appraisal process (e.g., ensures reviews are conducted in a timely manner, increases are processed quickly, and management performance appraisal is completed).

Maintaining Employee Relations

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.

• Utilizes an “open door” policy to address employee problems or concerns in a timely manner.

• Ensures effective employee communication channels are established and active in departments.

• Ensures employees establish and maintain open, collaborative relationships with their team members.

• Strives to improve employee retention.

• Monitors work environment for signs of union organization.

• Solicits employee feedback.

• Organizes Spirit to Serve Our Communities events.

Working as an Assistant Director of Human Resources at The Ritz-Carlton Abama  Resort means becoming part of a team where people are at the heart of the guest experience.

Join a team where people, leadership, and attention to every detail come together to create an extraordinary employee and guest experience.

Every day, we set the standard for unique and exceptional luxury service around the world, and we take pride in delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

jobs.title: Multi-property Director of Human Resources
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing the Human Resources Strategy

• Executes and follows-up on engagement survey related activities.

• Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.

• Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions

• Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.

• Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.

• Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow-up.

• Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.

• Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.

• Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.

• Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.

• Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.

• Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.

• Supervises one or more on-property Human Resources, as well as market-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.

Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process

• Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.

• Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.

• Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.

• Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.

• Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.

• Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.

• Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.

Managing Employee Compensation Strategy

• Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.

• Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.

• Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.

• Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.

• Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.

Managing Staff Development Activities

• Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).

• Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.

• Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.

• Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

This role is responsible for delivering high-quality HR services in areas including recruitment and onboarding, employee relations, compensation and benefits coordination, HR administration, associate engagement, and compliance with local employment legislation and company policies. Working closely with managers and key HR partners such as Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and Compensation & Benefits, the role helps ensure a consistent, compliant, and positive associate experience while supporting business priorities and operational effectiveness. Where applicable, the role may also provide coordination support for local office administration and workplace matters.

Job Location flexible within Jakarta, Indonesia or Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Length of Contract: 6 Months

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

- University degree in Human Resources management is preferred.

- At least 5–7 years of progressive human resources generalist or HR operations experience.

Skills and Competencies

- Strong Interpersonal skills to resolve sensitive issues with associates.

- Strong Verbal and written communication skills.

- Proficiency in HR systems and Microsoft Office applications, with strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

HR Systems and Reporting

- Maintains accurate and timely employee data in HR systems and ensures all updates are completed in accordance with company standards and local requirements.

- Generates and reviews regular HR reports and dashboards to decision-making.

- Monitors data quality, follows up on discrepancies, and works with relevant stakeholders to ensure HR records are accurate, complete, and up to date.

- Supports HR reporting requirements for audits, headcount, attrition, and other people metrics while maintaining confidentiality of employee information.

Recruitment and Selection

- Partners with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to support timely and effective recruitment.

- Supports compensation proposals for candidates in line with approved guidelines and communicates offers once approvals are obtained.

- Prepares offer documentation and coordinates onboarding to ensure a smooth and positive new hire experience.

Compensation & Benefits

- Ensures new hires are enrolled in benefit plans and communicates changes to the benefit plans in a timely manner.

- Coordinates payroll inputs and works closely with Payroll and C&B teams to ensure accurate and timely processing.

- Partners with Compensation & Benefits, Payroll, and other HR teams to deliver seamless and compliant HR support.

Training and Development

Associate Relations

- Maintains effective associate communication channels and supports local engagement initiatives.

- Provides guidance to associates and managers on company policies, code of conduct requirements, and fair treatment practices.

- Supports the timely resolution of associate concerns and employee relations matters using an open, fair, and consistent approach.

- Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure, and confidential medical file.

- Ensures proper documentation of all progressive disciplinary action is kept in associate file.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources - Sheraton Petaling Jaya
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing the Human Resources Strategy

• Executes and follows-up on engagement survey related activities.

• Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.

• Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions

• Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.

• Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.

• Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow-up.

• Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.

• Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.

• Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.

• Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.

• Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.

• Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.

• Supervises one or more on-property Human Resources, as well as market-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.

Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process

• Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.

• Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.

• Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.

• Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.

• Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.

• Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.

• Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.

Managing Employee Compensation Strategy

• Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.

• Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.

• Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.

• Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.

• Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.

Managing Staff Development Activities

• Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).

• Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.

• Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.

• Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources - Pre Opening Ritz Carlton Diriyah, Riyadh
jobs.description:
Director of Human Resources The Ritz-Carlton Diriyah | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia A Landmark Opportunity in One of the Kingdom’s Most Anticipated Luxury Destinations
Set within the historic landscape of Diriyah, the birthplace of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, The Ritz-Carlton Diriyah represents an extraordinary addition to one of the world’s most prestigious luxury hospitality brands. Combining the rich heritage of this UNESCO-recognised destination with contemporary sophistication and legendary service, the property is poised to redefine luxury hospitality in Riyadh.

We are seeking an exceptional Director of Human Resources to join the Executive Committee and play a pivotal role in shaping the culture, talent, and leadership capability of this flagship destination. This is a unique opportunity to influence the success of a landmark hotel while contributing to the continued growth of The Ritz-Carlton and Marriott International in the region.
About the Role
Reporting directly to the General Manager, with a functional reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources, the Director of Human Resources serves as a strategic business partner and trusted advisor to the hotel’s leadership team.

As a member of the Executive Committee, you will lead the development and execution of a people strategy that aligns with both property and brand objectives. You will oversee all aspects of talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession management, associate engagement, performance development, compensation strategy, and organisational effectiveness.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring the ability to balance business priorities with a people-first approach, ensuring the hotel attracts, develops, and retains exceptional talent while fostering an engaging and inclusive workplace culture.
Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute a comprehensive Human Resources strategy aligned with property goals, brand priorities, and business objectives.

- Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession management, and leadership pipeline development across the hotel.

- Champion associate engagement initiatives, including survey action planning, recognition programmes, and culture-building activities.

- Partner with department leaders to strengthen performance management, coaching, learning, and career development practices.

- Drive staffing optimisation and recruitment strategies that support operational excellence and future growth.

- Lead compensation and benefits initiatives, ensuring competitiveness, internal equity, and alignment with organisational priorities.

- Serve as a key change leader for organisational and people-related initiatives, supporting successful adoption and execution.

- Build strong relationships with ownership representatives, regional HR leaders, and key stakeholders, providing meaningful insights on talent, retention, and workforce performance.

The Ideal Candidate
The successful candidate will be an inspirational and commercially minded HR leader with a passion for luxury hospitality and a proven ability to create high-performing cultures.

You will bring:

- A collaborative and influential leadership style with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.

- Experience leading Human Resources within a luxury hotel, resort, or complex hospitality environment.

- Strong expertise across talent acquisition, employee relations, succession planning, compensation, and organisational development.

- Excellent commercial awareness and the ability to translate business priorities into people strategies that deliver measurable results.

- A genuine commitment to associate development, engagement, wellbeing, and inclusion.

- Experience leading change, developing future leaders, and building sustainable talent pipelines.

- A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, together with relevant professional experience within Human Resources or hospitality operations.

Why Join Marriott International?
At Marriott International , we believe our associates are the foundation of our success. Joining The Ritz-Carlton Diriyah means becoming part of a global organisation renowned for excellence, innovation, and opportunity.

In return, you will benefit from:

- Access to unparalleled global career opportunities across Marriott International’s world-class portfolio of brands.

- A strong commitment to learning, development, and leadership growth.

- The opportunity to shape the culture and success of a landmark luxury hotel.

- Exposure to a global network of hospitality professionals and industry-leading practices.

- The chance to make a meaningful impact within one of the world’s most respected luxury hospitality brands.

Your Next Chapter Starts Here
For leaders who are passionate about people, inspired by luxury hospitality, and motivated by the opportunity to shape an exceptional workplace culture, this role offers a rare career-defining opportunity.

Join The Ritz-Carlton Diriyah and help create an environment where exceptional talent thrives, remarkable careers are built, and legendary guest experiences begin with extraordinary people.

jobs.description:
Hotel Description

The Multi-Property Director of Human Resources oversees two properties and will be based at Phu Quoc Marriott Resort & Spa.

Phu Quoc Marriott Resort & Spa features 826 guestrooms and suites and offers an all-day dining restaurant, specialty restaurant, cafe, lobby lounge and bar, pool bar, swimming pools, fitness centre, Quan Spa and Kids Club. The resort also includes a grand ballroom, a junior ballroom and six meeting rooms providing a total of 3,296 sqm of event space.

W Phu Quoc features 526 guestrooms and suites and offers an all-day dining restaurant, specialty restaurant, W Living Room, cocktail bar, pool bar, swimming pool, fitness centre and AWAY ® Spa. Meeting facilities include four meeting rooms, providing a total of 325 sqm of event space.

They are scheduled to open in Q4 2027. Both properties are located within a mixed-use development featuring retail and casino offerings and are adjacent to the APEC multifunctional complex, which includes a 55,000 sqm convention centre. Phu Quoc International Airport is approximately 18 km away (30-minute drive), with direct air connectivity to Ho Chi Minh City (approximately 1 hour flight). Nearby attractions include Sun World/Hom Thom departure terminal (10-minute drive).

JOB SUMMARY

jobs.description:
Position Title:  Manager, HR Services Compensation & Benefits, APEC

Grade:  MRC 8

Reports to:  Director, Compensation & Benefits + HR Services, APEC

Location:  Mumbai

Role purpose

The Manager, HR Services C&B, APEC is responsible for supporting end-to-end compensation and benefits governance for Above Property across APEC. The role supports the planning and execution of annual compensation cycles, market benchmarking and analysis, reward-related reporting, payroll oversight, and benefits administration governance. Working closely with the HR Services team and C&B team, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, and regional stakeholders, the role helps ensure accurate, compliant, and audit-ready compensation, benefits, and payroll processes while improving consistency, data integrity, and service delivery for Above Property associates and leaders.

Key responsibilities

1. Compensation & Rewards Administration

- Support the administration and governance of compensation programs for Above Property associates across APEC.

- Coordinate annual compensation processes, including merit, bonus, salary reviews, and related reward activities.

- Prepare, validate, and maintain compensation data, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with established controls.

- Support job evaluations, market benchmarking, salary analysis, and reward-related reporting to inform compensation decisions.

- Partner with HR Services, Business Partners, and business leaders to create and guide compensation proposals and policies.

2. Benefits & Wellbeing Programs

- Support the administration and governance of benefits programs, including annual benefits review, plan design enhancements and implementation.

- Partner with benefits vendors, HR Services, and key stakeholders to ensure effective delivery of benefits programs and ongoing management of benefits programs.

- Coordinate with HR Services to ensure timely execution, accurate administration, and communication to associates regarding benefit offerings and changes.

- Support benefits-related market surveys and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program effectiveness and associate experience.

3. Payroll Governance & Compliance

- Partner with HR Services, Payroll, and Finance teams to support the accurate and timely processing of payroll-related compensation and benefits.

- Review and validate payroll inputs related to compensation, incentives, allowances, and benefits changes, ensuring accuracy and alignment with approved actions.

- Monitor payroll exceptions, discrepancies, and compliance risks, providing guidance and escalating issues as appropriate.

- Support payroll governance activities by maintaining controls, documentation, and audit readiness across compensation, benefits, and payroll processes.

4. Reporting, Analytics & Data Management

- Maintain the integrity and accuracy of compensation, benefits, and payroll data.

- Analyze reward data and trends, identifying insights and opportunities to support business and HR priorities.

- Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting tools to enhance visibility and decision-making.

5. Projects, Process Improvement & Governance

- Support regional Compensation & Benefits projects, including process standardization, system enhancements, and service delivery improvements.

- Develop and maintain policies, standard operating procedures, process documentation, templates, and communication materials.

- Partner with HR Services, Payroll, Finance, and other stakeholders to drive operational excellence and process efficiency.

- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance consistency, governance, and the associate experience across reward programs.

- Handle sensitive compensation, benefits, and payroll information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion.

- Support the end-to-end governance of compensation and benefits program processes for Above Property associates across APEC.

- Coordinate and support the planning, preparation and execution of annual compensation cycles, including merit, bonus, salary review and related reward processes.

- Prepare, validate and maintain compensation and benefits data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, confidentiality and audit readiness.

- Partner with HR Services to support market benchmarking, salary analysis and compensation-related reporting to inform decision-making and governance.

- Partner with HR Services, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance and other stakeholders to ensure reward-related transactions are processed accurately and on time.

- Manage payroll oversight activities for Above Property populations within scope, including recurring payroll inputs, validation, issue resolution and follow-up with payroll providers or internal teams.

- Support benefits administration governance, including coordination of benefit changes, eligibility reviews, associate communications and annual or recurring benefits activities.

- Maintain strong controls and documentation for compensation, benefits and payroll processes, ensuring compliance with company policies, approval requirements and applicable local requirements.

- Identify data discrepancies, process risks or compliance concerns and ensure timely escalation, follow-up and resolution.

- Prepare reports, dashboards, workforce and reward information for HR Services, C&B and business stakeholders.

- Support regional HR Services and C&B projects, including process standardization, system improvements, policy implementation and service delivery enhancements.

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process guides, templates and associate or manager communications related to compensation, benefits and payroll activities.

- Contribute to improved consistency, efficiency and quality across reward-related HR Services processes.

- Handle confidential and sensitive compensation, benefits and payroll information with appropriate discretion and professionalism.

- Perform any other duties and responsibilities as reasonably assigned or instructed by the business from time to time.

Required Skills and Experience

- Relevant experience in compensation and benefits, payroll, HR operations, HR shared services or a similar role supporting reward and associate-lifecycle processes.

- Good working knowledge of compensation, benefits and payroll processes, with the ability to support annual cycles, recurring activities and operational delivery.

- Experience working with HR, payroll or compensation data, including validation, reporting, reconciliation and issue resolution.

- Ability to manage recurring processes accurately and within agreed timelines, including compensation reviews, payroll inputs, benefits administration and audit requirements.

- Experience supporting multiple countries, markets or stakeholders in a regional environment.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, complete and confidential records.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Pyramid Global Hospitality . The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc.  The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

Position Overview

The Director of Sales (DOS) serves as the strategic second-in-command to the Director of Sales & Marketing (DOSM) and is responsible for leading the hotel's group sales efforts and driving topline revenue through direct sales activities.

This role focuses primarily on developing and growing group business across multiple market segments, including corporate, association, government, and SMERF.

Reporting directly to the Director of Sales & Marketing, the DOS is responsible for achieving individual and team sales goals through proactive prospecting, account management, client engagement, and business development initiatives. The position plays a critical role in the execution of the Sales & Marketing strategy, with a strong emphasis on direct revenue generation, market share growth, and account penetration. The ideal candidate is a results-driven sales leader with a proven track record of successfully securing and growing group business within competitive hotel markets. This individual is highly engaged in the sales process, excels at building client relationships, and possesses the leadership skills necessary to motivate and develop a high-performing sales team.

Key Responsibilities

-

Serve as the primary leader of the hotel's group sales efforts, driving revenue production across corporate, association, government, and SMERF market segments.

-

Act as the key support partner and strategic second-in-command to the Director of Sales & Marketing in the execution of the hotel's Sales & Marketing plan.

-

Lead proactive direct sales activities, including prospecting, solicitation, client appointments, site inspections, sales calls, networking events, and industry engagement.

-

Achieve individual and team group revenue goals through strategic account management and aggressive new business development.

-

Develop and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, meeting planners, third-party intermediaries, corporations, government agencies, and association partners.

-

Identify new business opportunities and expand existing accounts to maximize group room nights and overall hotel revenue.

-

Collaborate closely with Revenue Management and the DOSM to support group pricing strategies, forecasting, and business mix optimization.

-

Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to the sales team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and performance.

-

Monitor pace, production, market trends, and competitive activities to identify opportunities and adjust sales strategies as needed.

-

Maintain an active presence in the marketplace and represent the hotel at industry events, trade shows, and community functions.

-

Prepare and communicate accurate sales forecasts, production reports, and performance updates.

-

Support overall Sales & Marketing initiatives and ensure alignment with Pyramid Global Hospitality sales standards and best practices.

-

Work closely with hotel operations teams to ensure a seamless transition from sales to service and a positive client experience.

What are we looking for?

-

Bachelor's degree preferred in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

-

Minimum of 5+ years of progressive hotel sales experience, including at least 2 years in a sales leadership role within a full-service hotel environment.

-

Marriott brand experience preferred.

-

Demonstrated success driving group revenue and securing business within corporate, association, government, and SMERF market segments.

-

Strong direct sales background with proven achievement in prospecting, account management, and new business development.

-

Experience leading and developing sales professionals while maintaining an active personal sales portfolio.

-

Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

-

Strong understanding of hotel sales processes, forecasting, and revenue management principles.

-

Proficiency with hotel CRM systems, CI/TY, sales reporting tools, and related technology platforms.

-

Knowledge of the Washington, DC, Northern Virginia, and Mid-Atlantic markets strongly preferred.

-

Experience working with government, association, and corporate group business is highly desirable.

-

Highly motivated, results-oriented professional with a hands-on leadership style and passion for achieving sales goals.

Salary, incentive plan, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, RX, travel discounts, etc).

This company is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing Communications - The St. Regis Jakarta
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Marketing Communications is responsible for the planning, direction, control, and coordination of all communication activities, with an emphasis on public relations. Promotes and maintains good communications in order to enhance the prestigious image of the hotel and by doing so contributes to the revenues of the hotel.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required:

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Marketing Communications Activities

• Develops an annual communications plan with specific goals and budgets as outlined in the hotel's marketing plan/communications manual. Prepares working plans to achieve goals and ensures the communications team is fully briefed on goals and progress.

• Compares actual achievements against goals on a regular basis and takes corrective action.

• Assists the DOM in the planning of all mailing activities, and oversees their execution.

• Ensures that the corporate ID manual is kept up-to-date and implemented as appropriate.

• Prepares on a timely basis the monthly sales & marketing “communications” report.

• Supervises and directs photography for advertising, collateral and public relations purposes in liaison with the DOM, the advertising agency and the field marketing department at corporate office.

• Ensures the department has a comprehensive master slide/photo/CD library for all advertising, collateral and public relations activities, and regularly sends these to corporate office for the image library.

• Supervises operations of the in-house art department.

• Monitors activities of competitor hotels and trends within the industry.

Managing Public Relations Activities

• Acts as official spokesperson for the hotel when appropriate and responds to all media requests within 24 hours.

• Compiles and maintains a comprehensive list of media contacts and manages them as per the media account management system. Delegates assigned accounts to communications staff as appropriate but takes full responsibility for the key media by maintaining and developing close relationships

• Prepares press releases for appropriate targeted media, locally, regionally and internationally.

• Works closely with the corporate and international press offices on developing story angles.

• Plays a key role in community and government relations as well as VIP handling.

• Secures opportunities, directs and attends hotel sponsored events, and develops targeted partner relationships.

• Creates and organizes press promotional activities.

• Participates in the press events/trips organized by the regional PR offices as required.

• Conducts press blitzes when appropriate.

• Ensures press kit information is comprehensive and kept up-to-date.

Managing Advertising Activities

• Works with the DOM and advertising agency on the rooms and food & beverage tactical advertising campaigns' creative and media plans.

• Maximizes advertising budget by ensuring that the hotel's creative message and media activities are consistent with the advertising of sister hotels and the company group advertising.

• Ensures that the advertising creative is in synergy with the company, projecting a consistent and quality message.

• Reviews the hotel's market segmentation and other appropriate marketing reports to ensure that the media scheduling matches those segments.

• Monitors and maintains media schedules as well as prompt settlement of accounts.

Managing Direct Marketing Activities

• Takes an integrated approach to DM activities, ensuring a consistent and quality image is projected.

• Assists the DOM in the planning, implementation and tracking of electronic marketing activities.

• Maintains budget control.

Manages Collateral

• Coordinates and executes production of all printed materials, with assistance of advertising agencies, following the specifications stipulated in the corporate ID manual.

• Ensures hotel information is updated regularly on the internet/intranet.

• Supervises the production and quality of all displays and temporary signage in hotel public areas.

• Supervises and budgets for quality gift items as appropriate. Ensures correct usage of hotel logo on gift items as stipulated in corporate ID manual.

• Supervises the in-house graphic designer and/or print shop.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources- A
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing the Human Resources Strategy

• Executes and follows-up on engagement survey related activities.

• Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.

• Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions

• Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.

• Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.

• Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow-up.

• Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.

• Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.

• Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.

• Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.

• Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.

• Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.

• Supervises one or more on-property Human Resources, as well as market-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.

Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process

• Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.

• Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.

• Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.

• Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.

• Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.

• Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.

• Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.

Managing Employee Compensation Strategy

• Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.

• Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.

• Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.

• Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.

• Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.

Managing Staff Development Activities

• Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the property’s strategic financial business leader. The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 2 years experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

• Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

• Analyzes financial data and market trends.

• Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.

• Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.

• Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.

• Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.

• Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.

• Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans

• Protects and strengthens our competitive advantage by advocating and supporting sound business and financial decision making.

• Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.

• Implements a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.

Leading Accounting Teams

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.

• Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers' clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.

• Holds staff accountable for successful performance.

Developing and Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals

• Supports property strategy from a finance and accounting perspective

• Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.

• Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.

• Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Ensures appropriate corrections are made to audit results if necessary.

• Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.

Managing Projects and Policies

• Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.

• Generates and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

• Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).

• Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.

• Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).

Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

• Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).

• Understands the owners' perspective and ROI expectations.

• Anticipates and addresses owner needs and involves ownership in key decisions.

• Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the property's strategies and to lead own team.

• Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/financial issues.

• Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.

• Attends owners meetings in order to provide context and explanation for financial results.

• Attends meetings and communicates with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.

• Demonstrates a commitment to meeting the needs of all key stakeholders.

• Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.

• Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.

• Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

• Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
