jobs.title: Director of Sales (Based in Nha Trang)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Leads and manages all day-to-day activities related to the sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of property sales objectives. Achieves personal booking goals and makes recommendations on booking goals of direct reports.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Supporting Developing & Executing Sales Strategies

• Works with sales leader to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for the segment.

• Works with management team to create and implement a sales plan addressing revenue, customers and the market for the segment led by the DOS.

• Assists with the development and implementation of promotions, both internal and external.

Maximizing Revenue

• Provides positive and aggressive leadership to ensure maximum revenue potential (e.g., sets example with personal booking goals).

• Recommends booking goals for sales team members.

Managing Sales Activities

• Monitors all day to day activities of direct reports.

• Approves space release for catering to maximize revenue (DOS, Group) in the absence of a Business Evaluation Manager.

• Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.

• Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Analyzing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data

• Analyzes market information by using sales systems and implements strategy to achieve property’s financial room and catering goals.

• Assists Revenue Management with completing accurate six period projections.

• Reviews sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas of improvement.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies customer service and creates a positive example for guest relations.

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

• Meets with guests during pre- and post-convention meetings to obtain feedback on quality of product (e.g., rooms, meeting facilities and equipment, food and beverage), service levels, execution against contract and overall satisfaction.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.

• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of department meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

• Executes and supports the company’s Customer Service Standards and property’s Brand Standards.

• Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.

• Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.

• Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the company.

• Gains understanding of the property’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Building Successful Relationships

• Develops and manages relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external.

• Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., Event Booking Center, Market Sales, GSO) to ensure the property needs are being achieved and the sales efforts are complementary, not duplicative.

• Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to ensure compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.

• Attends customer events, trade shows and sales missions to maintain, build or develop key relationships with GSO Managers and customers.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Interviews and hires management and hourly employees with the appropriate skills to meet the business needs of the operation.

• Utilizes all available on the job training tools for employees.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Group & Events Sales Manager (Maternity Cover) - Excelsior Gallia
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Group & Events Sales Manager is responsible for generating, managing, and converting group accommodation, meetings, conferences, social events, and incentive business for Excelsior Hotel Gallia. The role focuses on maximizing revenue opportunities while ensuring an exceptional client experience from initial inquiry through event execution. Supports the Groups & Events Strategy and identifies and sources group leads that will meet hotel’s revenue goals. Provides management of accounts that have potential group opportunities for the hotel. These accounts and/or specific meetings are considered high-value by the hotel due to: group/meeting size, catering contribution, arrival/departure patterns, and meeting dates held during need times, holidays, or traditionally slow timeframes.  Manages the overall lead process, implementation of group initiatives, partnering with intermediaries as appropriate, providing on-going account service in the group segment, and closes coordination with the Proactive team on activities relating to the group segment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

- Relevant hospitality or event management certifications are advantageous.

- Minimum 3–5 years of experience in group sales, events sales, hotel sales, or hospitality business development.

- Experience within luxury or upscale hotels preferred.

- Proven success in managing group bookings, conferences, meetings, incentives, and special events.

- Experience with Marriott International systems and sales processes is a plus.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

- Actively solicit and secure new group and events business across corporate, association, luxury, entertainment, fashion, and social segments.

- Generate leads through prospecting, networking, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

- Conduct site inspections, client presentations, and hotel tours.

- Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

- Attend trade fairs, sales missions, and client networking events to promote the hotel.

- Respond promptly and professionally to requests for proposals (RFPs).

- Prepare customized proposals, contracts, and pricing solutions.

- Negotiate terms and conditions while optimizing profitability.

- Manage the full sales process from inquiry to contract signature.

- Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless event delivery.

- Build long-term relationships with key corporate accounts, agencies, meeting planners, and DMCs.

- Maintain regular contact with existing clients to drive repeat business.

- Conduct business reviews and identify opportunities for account growth.

- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.

- Achieve revenue goals for group rooms, meeting space, catering, and ancillary services.

- Work closely with Revenue Management to optimize pricing and inventory strategies.

- Monitor business pace, demand trends, and competitor activity.

- Forecast group and event business accurately and provide regular sales reports.

- Partner with Event Management and Operations teams during event handovers.

- Ensure all client requirements are communicated clearly and effectively.

- Participate in pre-event planning meetings and post-event evaluations.

- Support VIP events and high-profile client engagements when required.

- Applies the principles of strategic account management and team-based selling.

- Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

- Manages relationships with the  buyers of the accounts that book the largest and highest-valued leads to optimize account reach and share.

- Serves as account’s “local service guarantee” by establishing that outstanding service delivery is maintained at every customer touch point, issues are resolved timely and to the customers’ 100% satisfaction.

- Acts as the customer advocate through understanding account business objectives, needs and opportunities.

- Identifies emerging business opportunities and risks in the market to determine strategic Sales and Marketing implications and provide feedback to key stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Sales Team, Americas/Network Leadership, Group Sales within the Sales Office); partners with key stakeholders in account planning and determining strategy execution approaches for the market.

- Develops a close working relationship with Destination Sales Managers and hotel operations staff to execute strategies at the property level.

- Develops strategic relationships with secondary/non-central buyers with the purpose of driving market share and revenue to all Marriott brands

- Maintains proper and timely communication with the account customer(s) to verify overall satisfaction and quick resolutions

- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocate sound business decision-making; demonstrate honesty/integrity; lead by example.

- Collaborates effectively with peers, managers, and customers in a global and culturally diverse environment.

- Works effectively in a virtual team-based environment.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance System & Transformation
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Vice President, Finance System & Transformation is a senior leader responsible for defining and executing the multi-year strategy to modernize finance processes, data, and enabling technologies. This role leads end-to-end transformation programs spanning finance operating model, shared services evolution, process standardization, controls and governance, and enterprise finance platforms (e.g., ERP, planning, consolidation, reporting, and automation). The incumbent partners with Finance, Technology, and business leaders to deliver scalable capabilities, improve data integrity and decision support, enhance compliance, and drive measurable efficiency and service-quality outcomes across the organization.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience

- Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA/MFin) and/or professional qualification (CPA/ACCA/CIMA or equivalent) strongly preferred.

- 15+ years of progressive finance experience with significant leadership in finance transformation, finance systems/ERP programs, and process optimization.

- Proven track record delivering large-scale, cross-functional programs (multi-country / multi-business) from strategy through implementation and benefits realization.

- Deep knowledge of finance processes (record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, FP&A) and related controls, governance, and compliance requirements.

- Experience building shared services and/or center of excellence capabilities, including standard operating procedures, service catalogues, SLAs/KPIs, and continuous improvement.

Skills and Competencies

- Strong finance systems and data fluency (consolidation, planning, reporting/BI, master data, integration) with the ability to translate business needs into scalable solutions.

- Demonstrated expertise in process standardization, controls design, governance, and driving data integrity across end-to-end finance processes.

- Change leadership: builds sponsorship, manages resistance, and enables adoption through communication, training, and performance management.

- Program and portfolio management capabilities, including business case development, roadmap planning, dependency management, and benefits realization.

- Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence without direct authority and operate effectively with senior stakeholders.

- Strong communication skills; experience working across cultures and geographies. Hospitality industry knowledge preferred.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Finance Transformation Strategy & Roadmap

- Define and maintain the multi-year finance systems and transformation roadmap aligned to finance strategy, business priorities, and growth plans.

- Develop business cases, investment proposals, and benefits tracking to ensure value realization and transparency of outcomes.

- Finance Systems Leadership (Finance systems, Birchstreet, Procurement systems)

- Provide finance leadership for major platform implementations/enhancements, ensuring strong process design, controls, testing, cutover, and stabilization.

- Partner with Technology to define target architecture, integration approach, security and access controls, and data standards for finance applications.

- Process Standardization, Controls & Governance

- Drive standardized end-to-end finance processes, policies, and operating procedures to improve consistency, controllership, and audit readiness.

- Establish governance forums, decision rights, and change control to manage process and system changes effectively.

- Shape the finance operating model and shared services/CoE capabilities, including service catalogue, SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance.

- Identify and implement opportunities to eliminate redundancies, improve cycle times, and enhance service quality through standardization and digitization.

- Automation, Data & Insights

- Identify and prioritize automation opportunities (workflow, RPA, low-code, AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate) to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.

- Strengthen finance data foundations (master data, hierarchies, definitions) and enable actionable reporting and decision support for stakeholders.

- Leadership, Talent & Change Management

- Lead and develop a high-performing transformation organization (program, process, data, and systems roles), including capability building and succession planning.

- Embed structured change management, communication, and training to drive adoption and sustain new ways of working.

Success Measures (Illustrative)

- Delivery of finance systems roadmap milestones on time/on budget with strong controls and stakeholder satisfaction.

- Measurable efficiency gains (cycle time reduction, automation rate, cost-to-serve improvement) with sustained performance.

- Improved data quality and reporting reliability (reduced manual adjustments, fewer errors, clearer definitions and governance).

- Audit/compliance outcomes supported by standardized processes, documentation, and effective governance.

jobs.title: Director of Sales - Marriott Executive Apartments Hanoi West Lake
jobs.description:
HOTEL DESCRIPTION

Marriott Executive Apartments Hanoi West Lake is a 240‑key hotel comprising studio guestrooms and 1‑, 2‑, and 3‑bedroom apartments, each equipped with residential‑style amenities including a kitchen with stove, oven, refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, as well as washer and dryer. The hotel will form part of a mixed‑use development incorporating commercial and retail spaces and is scheduled to open in Q2 2027.

Facilities include a residents’ lounge, pool bar, swimming pool, fitness center, kids’ playground, BBQ area, and an arcade with pool table. The hotel also offers one meeting room of approximately 50 sqm, with an outdoor function space that potentially can be integrated with the pool deck and pool bar.

Located along Vo Chi Cong Road, the hotel is just a 15-minute drive from West Lake, one of Hanoi’s most vibrant lifestyle destinations, known for its diverse collection of restaurants, cafés, bars, boutiques, and picturesque lakeside experiences.

JOB SUMMARY

Leads and manages all day-to-day activities related to the sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of property sales objectives. Achieves personal booking goals and makes recommendations on booking goals of direct reports.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Supporting Developing & Executing Sales Strategies

Maximizing Revenue

• Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Analyzing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data

• Analyzes market information by using sales systems and implements strategy to achieve property’s financial room and catering goals.

jobs.title: Director of Finance - Sheraton Kota Kinabalu
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the property’s strategic financial business leader. The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 3 years experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

• Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 1 year experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

• Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.

• Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.

• Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.

• Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.

Leading Finance Teams

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.

• Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the property's strategies and to lead own team.

• Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.

• Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers' clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.

• Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to standard operating procedures.

Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

• Attends meetings and communicating with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.

• Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).

• Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/financial issues.

• Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.

• Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.

• Manages communication with owners in an effective manner.

• Manages property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand standard operating procedures and owner requirements.

• Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.

Developing and Maintaining Finance Goals

• Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.

• Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.

• Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.

• Develops and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Improves profit growth in operating departments.

• Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.

• Monitor the purchasing process as applicable.

Managing Projects and Policies

• Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

• Reconciles balance sheet to ensure account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with standard operating procedures.

• Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).

• Ensures compliance with management contract and reporting requirements.

• Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures.

• Ensures compliance with standard operating procedures.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.

• Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.

• Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

jobs.title: Reactive Group Sales Manager - The St. Regis Venice
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building strong relationships, generating new business opportunities, and turning exceptional events into unforgettable experiences? As a Reactive Group Sales, you will play a key role in driving the hotel’s commercial success by identifying, developing, and securing group business opportunities that contribute to revenue growth and position The St. Regis Venice as a premier luxury and MICE destination.

If you are results-driven, commercially minded, and thrive on developing strategic relationships with clients from around the world, we would love to meet you!

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required:

- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area OR 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred:

- University degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management.

- Lodging sales experience.

- Account management experience.

- Marriott sales systems experience

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

- Managing Sales Activities

- Identifying, developing, and managing business opportunities for group accommodation, meetings, incentives, conferences, and special events.

- Developing and implementing sales strategies aimed at maximizing revenue and market share within the group segment.

- Managing the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation through negotiation, contract signing, and post-sale follow-up.

- Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, event planners, travel agencies, destination management companies, and key accounts.

- Preparing customized proposals, contracts, and presentations tailored to each client’s specific requirements.

- Conducting site inspections, hotel presentations, and sales appointments to showcase the hotel’s facilities and services.

- Monitoring market trends, competitor activity, and emerging business opportunities to enhance sales performance.

- Working closely with Revenue Management teams to optimize pricing, availability, and profitability for group business.

- Collaborating with Events, Operations, and Catering teams to ensure seamless execution of contracted programs and events.

- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client, pipeline, and contract information within Marriott’s sales systems.

- Preparing sales reports, forecasts, and performance analyses for leadership teams.

- Ensuring compliance with Marriott International sales standards, policies, and procedures.

- Contributing actively to the achievement and surpassing of revenue and production goals established by the hotel.

- Understands the overall market  (e.g., competitors’ strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc.) and knows how to sell against them.

- Partners with Sales to identify new group/catering business and achieve personal and property revenue goals.

- Provides expert knowledge on local destination (e.g., local attractions, events, etc.)

- Coordinates with all sales channels to educate selling engines on property attributes and business needs.

- Verifies echannels and websites are updated with accurate details about the property.

- Provides other sales support as needed, upon direction from General Manager (GM) or sales leadership, within the overall sales strategy

- Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.

- Drives customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.

What we are looking for in you

-  Previous experience in hotel sales, group sales, MICE, events, hospitality business development, or a similar commercial role.

- Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

- A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering tailored solutions and exceptional experiences.

- A proactive, organized, and results-oriented approach to achieving business objectives.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market trends, sales reports, and business opportunities.

- Confidence working in international and multicultural environments.

- Experience using CRM platforms, hotel sales systems, and business development tools.

- Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with multiple departments.

- Fluency in Italian and English; additional languages will be considered a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Banquet Operations Manager
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Directs and motivates team while personally assisting in providing high quality service based on requirements and standards. Monitors and controls financial and administrative responsibilities including asset protection. Provides clear and concise communications to everyone having ownership in the success of the event. Identifies training opportunities and plans a strategy to accomplish goals.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Banquet Operations

• Projects supply needs for the department, (e.g., china, glass, silver, buffet presentations, props).

• Applies knowledge of all laws, as they relate to an event.

• Understands the impact of Banquet operations on the overall success of an event and manages activities to maximize customer satisfaction.

• Adheres to and reinforces all standards, policies, and procedures.

• Maintains established sanitation levels.

• Manages departmental inventories and maintains equipment.

• Uses banquet beverage records to control liquor costs and manage the banquet beverage perpetual inventory.

• Schedules banquet service staff to forecast and service standards, while maximizing profits.

jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Midwest Lodging Group . The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc.  The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Hotel General Manager to lead our hospitality team and oversee all aspects of hotel operations for a new construction SpringHill Suites by Marriott . This pivotal role requires a passionate leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, ensuring exceptional guest experiences while maintaining operational excellence. The ideal candidate will bring a comprehensive understanding of hospitality management, financial oversight, and team leadership to drive the hotel's success and uphold its reputation for outstanding service. Multilingual and bilingual skills are highly valued to connect with diverse guests and staff, fostering an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere.

Duties

-

Oversee daily hotel operations, including front desk, housekeeping, food and beverage, maintenance, and guest services, ensuring smooth coordination across departments.

-

Lead and supervise hospitality teams, providing clear direction, motivation, and support to achieve high standards of guest satisfaction and operational efficiency.

-

Manage hospitality operations budgets, including revenue management, cost control, and financial planning to maximize profitability.

-

Implement and uphold hotel management systems such as Property Management Systems (PMS) and hospitality reservation platforms to streamline booking processes and guest data management.

-

Develop and enforce hotel guest service standards to deliver exceptional customer service experiences that foster guest loyalty.

-

Handle guest relations by addressing concerns promptly, resolving issues effectively, and ensuring positive reviews.

-

Coordinate with human resources on staffing needs, training programs, performance evaluations, and maintaining a productive work environment.

-

Monitor hotel revenue streams through financial operations analysis, adjusting strategies as needed to meet business goals.

-

Maintain compliance with safety regulations, hotel policies, and industry standards while managing multi-line phone systems with professional phone etiquette.

Qualifications

-

Proven experience in hotel management or hospitality leadership roles with supervising experience in a fast-paced environment.

-

Strong knowledge of hospitality management principles including revenue management, budgeting, financial operations, and guest services.

-

Excellent managerial communication skills with the ability to lead diverse teams effectively.

-

Multilingual or bilingual abilities are preferred but not required to enhance communication with international guests and staff.

-

Proficiency in property management systems (PMS), hospitality reservation systems, and multi-line phone systems.

-

Demonstrated ability to oversee daily hotel operations while managing hospitality teams with professionalism and enthusiasm.

-

Exceptional customer service skills coupled with strong leadership qualities to motivate staff and elevate guest experiences.

-

Experience in human resources functions such as staffing, training, performance management, and conflict resolution is desirable.

Join us in creating memorable stays for our guests while leading a vibrant team committed to excellence!

Annual salary paid biweekly. Benefits:  Dental insurance, Employee discount, Health insurance, Paid time off, Professional development assistance, Vision insurance

-

Six-day work week with one weekend off per month and accrued vacation time.

-

Promote a positive and productive work environment through strong leadership and staff development

-

Strong commitment to franchise brand compliance

-

Work closely with sales and marketing teams to boost occupancy rates and increase brand recognition

-

Demonstrated experience in hotel management or a comparable role in the hospitality sector.

-

Strong grasp of revenue management techniques and industry practices.

-

Outstanding leadership abilities with a talent for motivating and developing team members.

This company is an equal opportunity employer.

- Food & Beverage Discounts  - 20% Discount in all F&B outlets within Marriott Properties

- Spa Discounts  – 30% discount in our Away Spa

SUMMARY

W Hotels does not recruit; we cast Talent. W London is casting a Senior Sales Manager. The Senior Sales Manager is accountable for proactively soliciting, handling sales opportunities and reaching revenue/room night targets for W London with a focus on local special corporate, luxury consortia and entertainment segments. This role is focused on revenues for these segments and involves a combination of account management and new business prospecting.

The Senior Sales Manager is also responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clients with the aim of creating loyalty and returning business. Proactive approach to drive new revenues and set up an action plan to achieve budgeted goals.

MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

This role requires the following responsibilities, which include but are not limited to;

Core Responsibilities:

- Actively participate in customer events, trade shows, and sales missions to develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers in the entertainment, luxury leisure, and special corporate sectors.

- Foster and grow long-term relationships with existing and potential clients, with a particular focus on high-value and high-potential business opportunities.

- Proactively identify and approach new clients, tailoring the presentation of hotel benefits and features to meet the unique needs of the entertainment, luxury leisure, and special corporate markets.

- Leverage creative selling, negotiation skills, and proactive outreach to secure new business and build a strong pipeline.

- Utilise digital marketing channels, including social media, email campaigns, and online advertising, to proactively target key audiences and drive awareness for hotel offerings.

- Champion the hotel’s service and relationship strategy by engaging with new clients, driving loyalty, and creating memorable guest experiences tailored to the needs of entertainment and luxury leisure groups as well as corporate clients.

- Develop, nurture, and expand relationships with both internal and external key stakeholders to ensure seamless collaboration across all departments.

Developing & Executing Sales Strategies:

- Collaborate with the sales leadership team to ensure full alignment with sales strategy and its effective implementation across the entertainment, leisure, and corporate segments.

- Proactively assist in the development, execution, and ongoing management of an aggressive solicitation programme aimed at growing business from entertainment, luxury leisure, and special corporate clients.

- Contribute to the creation and execution of targeted sales plans that address revenue generation, customer acquisition, and market positioning in these segments.

- Innovatively create and implement promotions that cater to the unique needs of entertainment, luxury leisure, and corporate clients, both internally and externally.

Maximising Revenue:

- Provide dynamic leadership, setting a proactive example for revenue maximisation through personal booking targets and consistent follow-through.

- Develop and implement sales strategies specifically tailored to the entertainment, luxury leisure, and special corporate segments while continually analysing market data to ensure objectives are met.

- Work collaboratively with the revenue management team to ensure strategies are aligned with maximising overall revenue potential.

Analysing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data:

- Analyse market trends and customer insights using sales systems to proactively refine sales strategies, ensuring the achievement of financial goals for the property.

- Assist Revenue Management with creating accurate, forward-looking six-period projections.

- Regularly review guest satisfaction metrics to identify areas for improvement and align sales strategies accordingly.

- Support the Director of Sales & Distribution with the preparation of detailed sales performance reports, including tracking KPIs, market trends, and competitor activities for senior management review.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service:

- Demonstrate leadership in guest hospitality, setting a high standard for customer service and ensuring that each client experience exceeds expectations.

- Proactively interact with clients to gather feedback and continuously refine service levels for entertainment, luxury leisure, and corporate segments.

- Empower team members to provide exceptional customer service by setting clear expectations and offering consistent feedback.

- Integrate guest satisfaction as a core component of departmental strategies and meetings, with a strong emphasis on continuous improvement.

- Support the company’s customer service standards and the hotel’s brand values, ensuring a seamless experience for each guest.

- Proactively drive guest satisfaction and loyalty by anticipating needs, offering tailored recommendations, and providing exceptional service throughout every event or stay.

- Understand each client’s unique business and service needs, offering solutions that align with their expectations and deepen the relationship.

To be considered for this role, all applicants must have proven right to work in the United Kingdom

jobs.description:
MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL

Corporate Senior Leader Job Description

Position Title:
Senior Director Sales & Distribution, West India & SAMHI
Date Created:
September 2026

Functional Job Family:

Primary Job Family:
51-Corporate Senior Leader

Career Band:
MRC - 12

Reports to:
VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia and Market Vice-President, West India
Department:
Consumer Operations (Sales & Distribution)

JOB SUMMARY
The Senior Director Sales & Distribution leads the sales and distribution agenda for a portfolio of hotels within the designated area. Reporting to the VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia and the Market Vice-President, West India, the role sets commercial direction, aligns property and multi-property sales teams with Marriott Commercial strategies and enterprise priorities, and strengthens customer and stakeholder relationships to deliver sustainable, profitable growth.

Accountable for revenue growth, market-share performance, business mix, channel profitability, and cost of sales, the Senior Director converts market intelligence into focused hotel-level strategies and execution plans. The role maintains regular communication with Market Vice President, West India and VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia, ensuring timely visibility of performance, risks, opportunities, and key decisions, and remains closely aligned with both reporting leaders on priorities and execution. Working with Revenue Management, Finance, National Sales, General Managers, and owners, the role optimizes direct and intermediate channels, builds commercial capability, and positions hotels to capture priority demand across market segments.
BUSINESS CONTEXT

- Travel is required approximately 50% of the time.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

- Graduate qualification required; a university degree is necessary.

- Eight to ten years of progressive hotel-industry experience, with a strong focus on sales, marketing, and distribution.

- Demonstrated experience leading commercial strategy across multiple properties or markets is preferred.

Skills and Competencies Commercial and Distribution Expertise

- Deep knowledge of hotel sales, digital commerce, distribution channels, strategic pricing, yield management, and account profitability.

- Proven ability to develop and implement successful sales and distribution strategies aligned with brand priorities and market conditions.

- Strong understanding of revenue management, sales contracts and commercial planning.

Leadership and Influence

- Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and talent-development capability.

- Ability to influence outcomes and align stakeholders in a matrix organization.

- Strong customer-development and relationship-management skills.

Business and Communication Acumen

- Ability to interpret market, financial, operational, and competitive data and convert insights into action.

- Working knowledge of operating and capital budgets.

- Excellent written, verbal, listening, negotiation, and presentation skills.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Area Commercial Leadership

- Partner with the VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia, the Market Vice-President, West India, and General Managers to set area sales priorities, accelerate revenue growth, and gain market share.

- Keep the Market Vice-President, West India and VP, Sales & Distribution, South Asia informed through regular, fact-based updates on business performance, market dynamics, risks, opportunities, and decisions requiring leadership alignment.

- Translate Marriott Commercial strategies and enterprise and regional priorities into clear area and hotel-level goals, deployment plans, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

- Provide strategic direction to hotel and above-property sales leaders, ensuring consistent focus and execution across the portfolio.

- Communicate initiatives clearly and recalibrate strategy in alignment with both reporting leaders as customer, competitive, and market conditions evolve.

Revenue, Market Share, and Business Planning

- Responsible for total revenue in hotels across rooms, catering and banquets, food and beverage, and other relevant revenue streams.

- Use market share, month-end, cost-of-sales, competitive, and business outlook data to identify growth opportunities and close performance gaps.

- Review and shape annual business plans and translate them into specific, measurable strategies by hotels and segment.

- Lead annual pricing, RFP, and RFI processes, with oversight of group contracts and business-evaluation recommendations.

- Conduct regular property and performance reviews, recognize strong delivery, and establish corrective action plans where results fall short.

Sales Strategy and Deployment

- Develop and execute area sales strategies that optimize hotels business mix and deploy resources against priority segments and accounts.

- Direct sales leaders across corporate, groups, catering, business travel, extended stay, reservations, and destination sales, as applicable.

- Lead field account management to accelerate strategic-account growth, acquisition, retention, and conversion.

- Monitor account deployment, lead flow, conversion, performance, and leakage across the GSO, National Sales Organization, properties, clusters, and EBCs.

- Embed disciplined account planning and pipeline management to expand existing accounts and capture new opportunities.

Revenue Management and Distribution

- Partner with Area Revenue Management to set and continuously refine pricing, channel, segment, and sales strategies in line with demand patterns and business outlook.

- Optimize distribution channels and loyalty programs to balance revenue growth, profitability, customer value, and cost of sales.

- Maintain a current view of competitor pricing, positioning, sales strategies, strengths, and vulnerabilities across priority segments.

Customer and Stakeholder Relationships

- Build trusted, commercially focused relationships with owners, General Managers, hotel leaders, customers, and internal discipline partners.

- Act as the voice of the customer and participate in strategic sales calls, negotiations, site inspections, customer events, and trade shows.

- Mobilize the GSO, NSO, cluster sales teams, EBCs, Revenue Management, and other functions to convert opportunities and deliver integrated customer solutions.

- Strengthening industry, community, and alliance relationships through relevant local, regional, national, and international forums.

Talent and Organizational Capability

- Build a strong sales leadership pipeline through disciplined selection, deployment, development, engagement, succession planning, and career progression.

- Coach and mentor sales leaders and associates to strengthen commercial capability, accountability, and performance.

- Review organization design, staffing levels, KPIs, and goals regularly, realigning resources and priorities where required.

Hotel Openings, Conversions, and Development

- Lead commercial planning and sales execution for hotel openings and conversions, including strategy, pricing, staffing, and pro forma input.

- Support development assessments, new-project planning, cluster design, and owner engagement.

Perform other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION STRATEGY

- Set hotel-level goals and incentives that grow profitable room nights through direct channels and strengthen demand acquisition.

- Assess intermediate channels on net revenue and cost of sales and redirect hotel activity to improve channel profitability.

- Partner with the Director, Distribution Strategy, South Asia to implement priority distribution initiatives across the area.

MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES Leadership

- Communication: Conveys information and ideas clearly, credibly, and persuasively through a range of methods.

- Leading Through Vision and Values: Keeps Marriott’s vision and values central to decisions and actions.

- Managing Change: Leads change, remove barriers, sustains momentum, and models composure under pressure.

- Problem Solving and Decision Making: Assesses issues and opportunities, compares evidence, evaluates alternatives, and selects an effective course of action.

- Professional Demeanor: Demonstrates confidence, earns respect, and represents the company in line with its values.

- Strategy Development: Identifies high-potential opportunities and develops practical business plans supported by disciplined evaluation.

Managing Execution

- Building a Successful Team: Builds cohesive, engaged teams focused on a shared mission.

- Strategy Execution: Converts business plans into coordinated action that improves customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share.

- Driving for Results: Sets high standards, establishes accountability, monitors progress, and acts proactively to achieve objectives.

Building Relationships

- Customer Relationships: Builds and sustains relationships grounded in customer and stakeholder needs and Marriott service standards.

- Global Mindset: Values diverse perspectives and uses them to strengthen innovation, engagement, and business results.

- Strategic Partnerships: Builds collaborative internal and external partnerships and connects disciplines, markets, and resources to achieve shared objectives.

Talent and Organizational Capability

- Organizational Capability: Adapts structures, assignments, and work processes to support business priorities.

- Talent Management: Provides guidance, coaching, and feedback that build the skills required to deliver objectives.

Professional Expertise

- Technical Acumen: Applies functional expertise to manage operations, solve commercial challenges, and develop innovative solutions.

- Sales Strategy and Implementation: Converts business requirements into practical sales solutions and leads successful implementation.

- Opportunity Analysis: Uses customer, economic, financial, industry, and organizational data to identify opportunities and inform action.

- Core Skills: Demonstrates sound computer literacy, mathematical reasoning, oral and reading comprehension, and written communication.

Business Results

- Sales Management: Builds top-line revenue through coordinated on-property and off-property sales channels.

- Revenue Management: Partners in pricing, segment mix, and strategy adjustments in response to market and economic conditions.

- Guest Satisfaction: Ensures sales processes meet customer needs, resolve issues, build loyalty, and improve market share.

- People Leadership: Develops and retains a capable, diverse workforce in an equitable and engaging environment.

- Financial Management: Supports disciplined budgeting, revenue growth, expense control, and returns for owners and Marriott International.

- Owner Relations: Builds trusted, respectful partnerships by meeting commitments and delivering against expectations.

jobs.title: Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives. Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

Education and Experience

Required:

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Sales and Marketing, Hawaii
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Area Director of Sales & Marketing provides strategic leadership and support to sales teams across all brands within the Hawaii and French Polynesia market. The position is responsible for achieving property revenue goals, team booking pace goals, guest and associate satisfaction, and the financial performance of the sales function at each participating property. The role evaluates and supports each hotel’s participation in appropriate sales channels and resources, including GSO, Account Sales, and Revenue Management, and builds strong working relationships to maximize value for participating hotels. In partnership with property teams and centralized marketing resources, the Area Director develops and activates demand-generation initiatives tailored to the needs of the Hawaii market. The role oversees both the group and leisure segment teams to drive revenue and achieve the individual goals of all participating properties. Serving as the in-market representative for participating managed and franchised hotels, the role collaborates with the Vice President of Luxury Sales on market-wide initiatives and helps ensure alignment across the portfolio. In partnership with Sales and Marketing leadership, the Area Director shares accountability for hotel performance and supports each property in achieving its total sales and revenue objectives, improving market share, and advancing major change efforts across the region.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required

•    4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related

•    6 years of relevant professional experience in sales management or related function, demonstrating progressive career growth and pattern of exceptional performance.

Preferred

•    Hawaii market sales experience

•    Should not include more than 3 preferred qualifications

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

- Provide strategic sales leadership and oversight for participating managed and franchised hotels across Hawaii and French Polynesia, aligning market priorities with each property’s revenue, booking pace, market share, and profitability goals.

- Lead and develop the group and leisure segment teams, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, deployment strategies, and accountability for achieving team and individual property goals.

- Evaluate hotel participation in GSO, Account Sales, Revenue Management, and other appropriate sales resources; strengthen relationships with these teams and ensure participating hotels receive measurable value from each channel.

- Partner with property leaders and centralized marketing resources to develop and activate demand-generation initiatives tailored to Hawaii and French Polynesia, including strategies that support need periods, priority segments, and market-wide opportunities.

- Serve as the in-market sales representative for participating managed and franchised hotels, providing market insight, advocating for property needs, and coordinating portfolio-wide sales priorities.

- Collaborate with the Vice President of Luxury Sales on market-wide initiatives, ensuring appropriate engagement, alignment, and execution across participating luxury and premium hotels.

- Monitor performance by hotel, segment, and sales channel; identify trends, risks, and opportunities; and guide timely adjustments to sales deployment, account focus, demand-generation activity, and resource allocation.

- Provide focused leadership and support to high-priority or underperforming hotels, partnering with property and discipline leaders to establish action plans, address performance gaps, and accelerate revenue improvement.

- Partner with Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, and property leadership to align segment strategies, pricing and inventory priorities, promotional activity, and sales execution with changing market conditions.

- Build trusted relationships with General Managers, owners, franchisees, sales leaders, and other key stakeholders; facilitate balanced decisions that support individual hotel objectives and the long-term performance of the market.

- Communicate business trends, competitive intelligence, airlift and demand developments, and market events that may affect hotel performance; translate insights into clear sales actions for participating properties.

- Ensure consistent execution of company and brand sales strategies, standards, tools, and processes, while identifying and sharing best practices across properties and disciplines.

- Support hotel openings, conversions, and portfolio changes by establishing effective sales plans, team deployment, account coverage, and demand-generation strategies before and after transition.

- Champion major sales and organizational initiatives across the market, providing feedback to senior leadership and ensuring effective implementation, adoption, and sustained results.

jobs.title: Learning & Development Manager
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Administering Employee Training Programs

• Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.

• Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.

• Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.

• Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness

• Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.

• Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.

• Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.

• Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.

Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets

• Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision.

• Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.

• Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.

• Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.

• Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.

• Develops specific training to improve service performance.

• Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.

• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

Managing Training Budgets

• Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.

• Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.

• Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

• Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

jobs.title: Intern, Learning & Development Operations (Jan to Jun 2027)
jobs.description:
CORPORATE INTERNSHIP PROGRAM

Marriott International offers students the opportunity to find an internship that’s right for you, putting your education to work. The Marriott International Corporate Internship Program offers all participants an enriching and memorable learning experience.

Interns will experience an innovative learning environment that will provide an opportunity to build skills and gain exposure in the exciting world of hospitality through meaningful projects, on-the-job training, coaching, and support. You’ll gain hands-on experience in the exciting world of hotel operations and hospitality from a corporate view. You’ll build skills to help prepare you to develop a career path.

JOB SUMMARY

The Learning & Development Operations Intern supports the planning, coordination, administration, and reporting of regional learning programs across APEC managed and franchise properties. This role helps ensure associates have access to the right learning opportunities by supporting Learning Experience Platform (LXP) administration, enrollment tracking, learner follow-up, virtual learning production, completion reporting, and program closeout. The intern will also assist with learning resources, job aids, presentation materials, and communications for Marriott’s digital transformation deployments. Working closely with the regional L&D team and key stakeholders, this internship offers practical exposure to how large-scale learning initiatives are delivered across a complex hospitality organization.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree or diploma in Human Resources, Hospitality, Business Administration, Learning & Development, Communications, or a related field

- Strong interest in hospitality, associate development, learning technology, and employee experience

- Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams

- Detail-oriented, organized, service-minded, and able to follow through on tasks in a fast-paced environment

Skills and Attributes

- Strong coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple learning administration tasks

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence supporting stakeholders across different markets

- Curious and proactive mindset, with a willingness to learn new systems, processes, and ways of working

- Ability to handle data and learning records accurately and responsibly

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

- Support the administration and coordination of regional webinars, virtual learning sessions, and training programs across APEC, including enrollment tracking, communications, logistics, attendance monitoring, and reporting.

- Assist with end-to-end virtual session production using tools such as Microsoft Teams, surveys, polls, breakout rooms, and chat features to create a smooth and engaging participant experience.

- Set up, maintain, and update learning programs in the Learning Experience Platform (LXP), helping ensure accurate course configuration, learner access, user profiles, and completion records.

- Manage learning enrollment activities, including registering participants, tracking attendance, monitoring learner progress, resolving basic enrollment queries, and following up on overdue completions.

- Prepare and maintain learning completion trackers, dashboards, certificates, and program closeout documentation to support visibility of learning participation and compliance.

- Support the deployment of Marriott’s digital transformation journey and other L&D initiatives by coordinating learning resources, job aids, presentation materials, stakeholder updates, and training administration requirements.

- Serve as a support point of contact for learning administration questions, escalating issues where needed and providing timely, service-oriented assistance to associates, managers, and L&D partners.

Other Responsibilities

- Seek feedback, apply learning, and continuously improve the quality and accuracy of assigned work.

- Communicate with stakeholders in a warm, professional, and service-oriented manner consistent with Marriott’s culture.

-
Perform other related duties as assigned to support the regional Learning & Development team.

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

- Regional exposure to Marriott’s Learning & Development function across APEC, including how learning programs are planned, launched, tracked, and sustained across managed and franchise properties.

- Hands-on experience with learning technology, including course setup, learner administration, completion tracking, and reporting through learning platforms.

- Practical skills in virtual learning production, including session setup, participant engagement, facilitator support, and troubleshooting during live programs.

- Opportunities to build professional communication, stakeholder management, project coordination, and service excellence skills in a regional corporate environment.

- A stronger understanding of Marriott’s people-first culture and how Learning & Development supports associate growth, operational readiness, and business performance.

JOB SUMMARY:

As a key member of Greater China finance and the global Enterprise Procurement leadership team, this role brings deep functional expertise to shape and advance both strategic and operational objectives. Operating with a high degree of independence, the leader sets short-term goals aligned with broader business and the region’s priorities, while managing a geographically dispersed team of associates. Recognized as a subject matter authority, this role serves as the primary Procurement interface with other business functions and holds responsibility for category management, sales, account management and acquisition activities that deliver strategic value.

The leader is accountable for developing and executing the Greater China Procurement strategy through its functional transformation in multiple years ahead; meanwhile managing internal and external customer relationships to achieve desired business outcomes. The leader will establish and sustain a market-facing operating model to support managed and franchise hotels while establishing the functional capability for design supply procurement in the region to provide differentiated value propositions for franchise partners. The leader will liaise closely internally with enterprise stakeholders and externally with managed hotels, franchise partners and suppliers. A core priority is building a high-performing team to drive customer satisfaction and drive participation in the program.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required Education:

•           4-year bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance or Hotel Management or supply chain management

OR

•           Master in Business Administration (MBA) or Master degree in finance, operations or hospitality preferred

Required Experience:

•           Over 10 years of business management leadership experience.

•           Procurement/Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, Customer Relationship Management, Asset Management, and other customer facing leadership experience.

•           Direct experience managing project teams and individuals in a high growth and fast paced environment.

•           Working knowledge of hospitality supply chain inclusive of sourcing, purchasing, delivery and procurement operations.

•           Multiple national companies working experience is preferred

Preferred Experience:

•           Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in an enterprise, global environments, with a proven ability to drive major change across matrixed organizations.

•           Exceptional program and project management capabilities, with expertise in planning, budgeting, resource alignment, and execution across multiple workstreams.

•           Strategic communicator and relationship builder, skilled in translating complex ideas into clear business terms and fostering high-performing, collaborative teams.

•           A track record of building organizational capability and operational excellence.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

•           Define and execute the Greater China multi-year procurement strategy in alignment with enterprise priorities, anticipating market shifts and supporting Marriott’s growth trajectory.

- Establish regional design supply chain and its platform to design product localization and elevate support for owner’s design, construction, openings and renovations – delivering a cost effective solution which enables properties to open on schedule and under budget.

•           Drive growth and program participation by developing differentiated value propositions for internal and external customers.

•           Establish a robust support model managed and franchise hotel re-supply categories (food, beverage, operating supplies, services, etc), this includes the development of account management and acquisition efforts, building trusted relationships with owners, operators, franchisees, and suppliers.

•           Identify and pursue new business opportunities, leveraging market intelligence and customer insights.

•           Drive shared strategic value from Marriott supplier relationships, ensuring compliance with contract obligations and optimizing on- and above-property engagement to maximize value (e.g., improved hotel participation, retention, and onboarding support).

•           Identify sourcing opportunities from customers, share business requirements and oversee successful completion in partnership with the sourcing & category management team.

•           Define, market and deliver value to customers for all extended Marriott procurement programs. Build trusted relationships with owners, operators and franchise management companies.

•           Actively assess Marriott procurement solutions competitiveness and make necessary adjustments to the operating model to ensure market share growth and customer satisfaction.

•           Represent regional needs to shape enterprise strategies for discipline partners.

•           Design and deploy a repeatable approach to support procurement for new builds and renovations—balancing cost, speed, and alignment with brand standards.

•           Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration & Alignment by partner with Finance, Asset Management, and Franchise Services to identify enterprise-wide leveraging opportunities and support owner/franchisee engagement strategies.

•           Develop talent through structured training programs, performance management, and leadership development across a geographically dispersed team.

•           Create a work environment that prioritizes fairness, associate satisfaction, and ethical business practices, in partnership with HR, to attract and retain top-tier talent.

•           50% travel domestically and internationally

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Sage Hospitality . The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc.  The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

The Nines, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Portland

One of our early pride-and-joys, The Nines Portland is an adaptive reuse project that turned the historic Meier & Frank Building into a magnificent luxury hotel in downtown Portland, Oregon. Sage developed the hotel and brand, focusing on honoring its rich history while bringing it forward with modern, eclectic design and branding. We sold it to its current owners in 2014, and it carries forward as a gem in Portland’s downtown, housing two of the city’s top restaurants, Urban Farmer and Departure. Situated in the midst of museums, the Japanese Gardens, and a vibrant retail district, The Nines remains a standard bearer for Sage.

-

Promotes associate moral and loyalty within their department and hotel, leading to reduced turnover. Communicate, counsel and assist in staff development. Assure level of experience, knowledge and ability to meet job requirements of all hotel management. Cost Controls Review controls and assure adherence at all times in order to protect the hotel's property/assets.

• Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales + Catering Implementation, Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL

Advertised Position Title:
Manager, Sales + Catering Implementation, Asia Pacific
Grade:
8

Reports to:
Director, Sales + Catering Systems

Department Name:
Distribution
Position ID #:

JOB SUMMARY

Supports the implementation and delivery of Marriott’s Sales & Catering Solutions to Marriott properties and above-property locations within APEC & Greater China. Works closely with Sales, Events, Banquet Operations, Revenue, IT, Finance, and HR property teams to ensure that the applicable Sales & Catering solution (e.g., CI/TY, SFAWeb/GPO, OneSource) is successfully implemented. Provides post-go-live support to APEC & Greater China properties to ensure business and functionality processes are adopted to maximize application usage in order to achieve the key goals of optimizing revenue and profit across the total hotel, building customer loyalty by enhancing response, and improving associate effectiveness.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required

-
4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, or related major and 2+ years of relevant professional experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance;

OR

- 4+ years of relevant professional experience in marketing or related function, demonstrating progressive career growth and pattern of exceptional performance.

- Languages: Japanese and  Mandarin preferred ;  English required.

Preferred

- Demonstrated ability to deliver results, effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

- Ability to troubleshoot, analyze, and communicate issue details clearly in real time.

- Strong project management and organizational skills with a service mindset.

- Strong understanding and capabilities utilizing Microsoft Office suite.

- Strong knowledge of Marriott Sales & Catering systems.

- Analytical and audit skills.

- Strong track record in collaborative planning and decision-making with a variety of stakeholders and organizations.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Sales and Catering Implementation

- Coordinates the pre-planning, training and delivery activities for the specific S&C solution (including all associated business process and reporting needs).

- Influences and mentors associates and leaders in the training and implementation process.

- Manages the on-site / remote implementation of supported systems and business process.

- Ensures all pre-cutover activities are complete and all user provisioning and IT/network activities are in place prior to go-live.

- Supports post-cutover stabilization, collects feedback on continuous improvement, and communicates feedback to the S&C support team.

- Looks for opportunities for more efficient and effective delivery of S&C solutions in conjunction with other disciplines (e.g. PMS, IT, Reservations, etc.).

- Creates a strategic plan for business unit leaders to ensure successful use of sales and group technology.

- Identifies training gaps, provides feedback on existing training materials and curricula, and partners with Learning + Development to produce effective training materials.

- Manages compliance to training requirements and communicates results to property, continent and company leaders.

- Travels (up to 75% of the time) to provide subject matter expertise and in-market implementation support of sales and group technology.

- Transitions property to the post-implementation support model once deployment is complete.

Provide Continent, Market, Property, and Location Support

- Provides detailed consultative collaboration to property, market, and continent leadership to improve system use, increase associate productivity, and influence compliance with standard processes.

- Develops and fosters relationships with continent, market, property, franchise partner and headquarters leadership.
